paragraphs.text: K. Arsenault Rivera is a writer and an Associate Narrative Designer at Wizards of the Coast .

Arsenault Rivera was born in Mayaguez, Puerto Rico, US, and raised in New York, US. She is the author of the Ascendant trilogy, as well as a writer on Batman: The Blind Cut and The Shadow Files of Morgan Knox. She's a lifelong Brooklynite and a fan of all things nerdy. She drew on her love of tabletop gaming for her debut novel and celebrated its release with a Magic: The Gathering tattoo. An out and proud queer, she lives in Seattle with her partner.
Arsenault Rivera has contributed to the Magic Story since Innistrad: Midnight Hunt .

In June 2025, she became fully employed by Wizards of the Coast as an Associate Narrative Designer. She is the author for The Incoming Student's Guide to Strixhaven: A Young Planeswalker's Guide , which will be released in 2027.
